name: Jen'nu
source: A fan of the Hosekizuka Troupe, her dream is to one day become a member. She has elegance, beauty, and dignity that always shine brightly over her peers. Although she may epitomize beauty, Jennu is also strong, brave, and more fearless that the boys. Despite being an elementary school student, she takes on the guardian role in the group and tries to look out for everyone. However, if you make fun of the Hosekizuka Troupe, she'll fly into a rage, and has brawled with others in the past.
